{"type":"thought","data":"The market is a draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prediction for FC Augsburg"}
{"type":"thought","data":" versus 1. FC Union "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Berlin."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe draw price of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.235 matches the bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implied probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 24%. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" key question is whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value or simply pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the most probable outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" is being"}
{"type":"thought","data":" interpreted as the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome with the highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability of being"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correct. A No bet at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.765 would return "}
{"type":"thought","data":"roughly 130 tokens if"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correct, while a Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet at 0.235 would "}
{"type":"thought","data":"return roughly 427 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's historical"}
{"type":"thought","data":" P&L data reveals a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"clear pattern. Small"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gains came from betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on favorites at prices"}
{"type":"thought","data":" around 0.84. Large "}
{"type":"thought","data":"wins came from underdogs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at prices around 0.52"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 0.44. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the user favors high-reward"}
{"type":"thought","data":" underdogs over safe"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorites."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's 14-6 record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and +266.6 net P&L "}
{"type":"thought","data":"confirm this is a P&L-driven"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competition. The goal"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is to maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profit, not just pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the most probable outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Each agent places one"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet, and the winner"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is determined by the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" highest payout."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market appears"}
{"type":"thought","data":" efficiently priced."}
{"type":"thought","data":" True draw probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimates from bookmakers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and models sit near"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 24 to 26 percent, nearly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matching the 0.235 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"price. This leaves little"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge either way. If"}
{"type":"thought","data":" multiple agents pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the same side, they"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tie with identical "}
{"type":"thought","data":"payouts."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show a slight edge "}
{"type":"thought","data":"on the draw. Betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes at 0.235 yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly +2.13 profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 24 percent, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" betting No at 0.765"}
{"type":"thought","data":" returns about +30.72."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.235 is therefore "}
{"type":"thought","data":"slightly below the implied"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" analysis now covers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the full range of model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimates. At a 26 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"percent draw probability,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the draw bet yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly +10.6 profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while the no-draw side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" loses about -3.27. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"At 22 percent, the draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side loses about -6.38"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the no-draw side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gains about +1.96. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"These figures confirm"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price sits"}
{"type":"thought","data":" almost exactly at the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" consensus fair value.\n\nThe most probable "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome is No, with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"roughly a 76.5 percent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance of the match"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not ending in a draw."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRecent match context"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favors the No side."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Sports Mole predicts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" an Augsburg win, and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Football Whispers suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Over 2.5 goals. Both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" teams have scored over"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2.5 goals in every "}
{"type":"thought","data":"game this season."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nOver 2.5 goals and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" both teams to score"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are each priced at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"64 percent. Augsburg"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has scored 16 goals"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in six games but also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" concedes heavily. Union"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Berlin is struggling"}
{"type":"thought","data":" away, scoring zero "}
{"type":"thought","data":"goals and zero points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this season. They lost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" three of their last"}
{"type":"thought","data":" five away matches and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" were humbled by Bayern."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Augsburg is unbeaten"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at home in the last"}
{"type":"thought","data":" five games. The team"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has drawn recently "}
{"type":"thought","data":"against Bayern and Leverkusen."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nn-tv experts specifically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tip the draw because"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Augsburg has drawn "}
{"type":"thought","data":"twice at home this season."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The last fourteen meetings"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show six Augsburg wins,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" four draws, and four"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Union wins. Union's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 4-0 victory in their"}
{"type":"thought","data":" last encounter makes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a repeat unlikely. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"If Union cannot score"}
{"type":"thought","data":" away, a 0-0 draw is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" possible but Augsburg's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" strong home offense"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggests a win is more"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probable."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA Poisson model estimates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Augsburg around 1.8"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected goals and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Union around 0.9, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lands the draw probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 24 to 26 percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This confirms the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sits at the Bundesliga"}
{"type":"thought","data":" base rate. The next"}
{"type":"thought","data":" step is determining"}
{"type":"thought","data":" how to win the bench"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competition."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe exact execution"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mechanics of `bench"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet` are unclear. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" displayed prices are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" midpoints, but the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"actual fill price could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be the ask or a fixed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rate. This determines"}
{"type":"thought","data":" whether the expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value calculation is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" accurate."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe `bench bet --help`"}
{"type":"thought","data":" command needs to be"}
{"type":"thought","data":" checked to confirm "}
{"type":"thought","data":"how orders are filled."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe competition is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a P&L race. If most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents pick No, they"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will all tie with identical"}
{"type":"thought","data":" small payouts. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"only way to win is to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick the opposite side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and hope it resolves"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correctly.\n\nA No bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields roughly +30 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"tokens if correct, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" costs -100 if wrong."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A Yes bet yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +325 if correct, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" costs -100 if wrong."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This makes the underdog"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side far more profitable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" when it wins."}

\n\n[Union Berlin](/football/union-berlin/) \n\n# Preview: Augsburg vs Union Berlin - prediction, team news, lineups\n\nBy [Lewis Nolan](/team/lewis-nolan/) | 22 Oct 2026 17:57, Last updated: 22 Oct 2026 23:14 \n\n![Augsburg vs Union Berlin - prediction, team news, lineups](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/fu_ZS0bJJbawEcr9oZqxXDBkQnU=/720x540/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fmichael-gregoritsch-2-6ada401f6cf6a271673536.jpg) \n\n© Iconsport / Mis\n\nA defeat for [Union Berlin](/football/union-berlin/ \"Union Berlin\") against hosts [Augsburg](/football/augsburg/ \"Augsburg\") on Saturday at WWK Arena could leave them stranded in the **[Bundesliga](/football/bundesliga/table.html)**'s bottom three.\n\nThe home side are 10th with eight points, whereas Union are 17th with just five points, and a loss could leave them three points from safety by the end of matchweek seven.\n\n* * *\n\n## Match preview\n\nAugsburg have started to slide down the table, with the club taking just two points from their last four games in the top flight, whereas they had won both of their opening fixtures.\n\nTheir latest result was particularly concerning given they lost **[4-3 against newly-promoted Elversberg](/football/elversberg/preview/elversberg-vs-augsburg-prediction-team-news-lineups_606909.html)** on October 17, conceding twice in the first seven minutes of the clash.\n\nBoss [Manuel Baum](/people/manuel-baum/ \"Manuel Baum\") will highlight that his side netted three times in that loss, and while two of their strikes were penalties, his team have scored at least two goals in all seven of their matches this term in all competitions.\n\nThe hosts are unbeaten at home so far this season, and though they have drawn their last two outings at WWK Arena, they were able to hold Bayern Munich to a 2-2 stalemate on October 10.\n\nHowever, Augsburg conceded four goals in those two draws, and they have kept just one clean sheet in their past seven fixtures at home while winning twice.\n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/ZJRGo-O6_pQSO_XMFOHY1vIIPn4=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F09%2Fbeautiful-sports-international-beautiful-sports-pressphoto-agency-alamy-union-berlin-manager-mauro-lustrinelli-pictured-on-september-5-2026-6aa1d6ff84449015766192.jpg)\n\n© Iconsport / Beautiful Sports International, BEAUTIFUL SPORTS Pressphoto Agency, Alamy\n\nUnion Berlin's season has been disappointing, but they have started to improved in recent weeks given they have taken four points from their past two Bundesliga games.\n\n[Mauro Lustrinelli](/people/mauro-lustrinelli/ \"Mauro Lustrinelli\") oversaw an impressive goalless stalemate with **[Borussia Dortmund on October 17](/football/union-berlin/bundesliga-title-race/preview/union-berlin-vs-dortmund-prediction-team-news-lineups_606997.html)**, as well as a 1-0 triumph against Elversberg on October 10.\n\nThe visitors' record against their hosts has been strong, with the club undefeated in their three most recent meetings, winning twice and drawing once.\n\nDie Eisernen's form on their travels has been poor considering they lost both of their two Bundesliga matches on the road this term, and they were also beaten in three of their final four away league matches in 2025-26.\n\nIn their two top-flight away contests this campaign, Union not only failed to find the back of the net, but they also conceded seven goals.\n\nAugsburg Bundesliga form:\n\n*   W\n*   W\n*   D\n*   L\n*   D\n*   L\n\nUnion Berlin Bundesliga form:\n\n*   D\n*   L\n*   L\n*   L\n*   W\n*   D\n\n* * *\n\n## Team Iconsport / PictureAlliance\n\nAugsburg could be missing as many as six players on Saturday, including forward Alexis Claude-Maurice, who is not scheduled to return until early November.\n\nMichael Gregoritsch is likely to continue to lead the attacking line, supported by Anton Kade and Arijon Ibrahimovic in a front three.\n\nDefender Noahkai Banks is nearing a return from a knee injury, though he will not be available for the weekend's clash, meaning Chrislain Matsima, Jeffrey Gouweleeuw and Calvin Brackelmann are set to feature in central defence.\n\nAs for Union, there are doubts about the fitness of striker Andrej Ilic, so if he is unable to play, then expect to see Woo-Yeong Jeong and Tim Skarke stationed together in attack.\n\nMidfielders Andras Schafer and Rani Khedira, may play ahead of centre-backs Zeno Van den Bosch and Felix Uduokhai.\n\n**Augsburg possible starting lineup:**\n\nDahmen; Matsima, Gouweleeuw, Brackelmann; Fellhauer, Massengo, Rieder, Behrens; Kade, Ibrahimovic; Gregoritsch\n\n**Union Berlin possible starting lineup:**\n\nRonnow; Haberer, Van den Bosch, Uduokhai, Rothe; Aebischer, Schafer, Khedira, Imeri; Jeong, Skarke\n\n* * \n\n[Union Berlin](/football/union-berlin/) \n\n# Preview: Augsburg vs Union Berlin - prediction, team news, lineups\n\nBy [Lewis Nolan](/team/lewis-nolan/) | 22 Oct 2026 17:57, Last updated: 22 Oct 2026 23:14 \n\n![Augsburg vs Union Berlin - prediction, team news, lineups](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/fu_ZS0bJJbawEcr9oZqxXDBkQnU=/720x540/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fmichael-gregoritsch-2-6ada401f6cf6a271673536.jpg) \n\n© Iconsport / Mis\n\nA defeat for [Union Berlin](/football/union-berlin/ \"Union Berlin\") against hosts [Augsburg](/football/augsburg/ \"Augsburg\") on Saturday at WWK Arena could leave them stranded in the **[Bundesliga](/football/bundesliga/table.html)**'s bottom three.\n\nThe home side are 10th with eight points, whereas Union are 17th with just five points, and a loss could leave them three points from safety by the end of matchweek seven.\n\n* * *\n\n## Match preview\n\nAugsburg have started to slide down the table, with the club taking just two points from their last four games in the top flight, whereas they had won both of their opening fixtures.\n\nTheir latest result was particularly concerning given they lost **[4-3 against newly-promoted Elversberg](/football/elversberg/preview/elversberg-vs-augsburg-prediction-team-news-lineups_606909.html)** on October 17, conceding twice in the first seven minutes of the clash.\n\nBoss [Manuel Baum](/people/manuel-baum/ \"Manuel Baum\") will highlight that his side netted three times in that loss, and while two of their strikes were penalties, his team have scored at least two goals in all seven of their matches this term in all competitions.\n\nThe hosts are unbeaten at home so far this season, and though they have drawn their last two outings at WWK Arena, they were able to hold Bayern Munich to a 2-2 stalemate on October 10.\n\nHowever, Augsburg conceded four goals in those two draws, and they have kept just one clean sheet in their past seven fixtures at home while winning twice.\n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/ZJRGo-O6_pQSO_XMFOHY1vIIPn4=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F09%2Fbeautiful-sports-international-beautiful-sports-pressphoto-agency-alamy-union-berlin-manager-mauro-lustrinelli-pictured-on-september-5-2026-6aa1d6ff84449015766192.jpg)\n\n© Iconsport / Beautiful Sports International, BEAUTIFUL SPORTS Pressphoto Agency, Alamy\n\nUnion Berlin's season has been disappointing, but they have started to improved in recent weeks given they have taken four points from their past two Bundesliga games.\n\n[Mauro Lustrinelli](/people/mauro-lustrinelli/ \"Mauro Lustrinelli\") oversaw an impressive goalless stalemate with **[Borussia Dortmund on October 17](/football/union-berlin/bundesliga-title-race/preview/union-berlin-vs-dortmund-prediction-team-news-lineups_606997.html)**, as well as a 1-0 triumph against Elversberg on October 10.\n\nThe visitors' record against their hosts has been strong, with the club undefeated in their three most recent meetings, winning twice and drawing once.\n\nDie Eisernen's form on their travels has been poor considering they lost both of their two Bundesliga matches on the road this term, and they were also beaten in three of their final four away league matches in 2025-26.\n\nIn their two top-flight away contests this campaign, Union not only failed to find the back of the net, but they also conceded seven goals.\n\nAugsburg Bundesliga form:\n\n*   W\n*   W\n*   D\n*   L\n*   D\n*   L\n\nUnion Berlin Bundesliga form:\n\n*   D\n*   L\n*   L\n*   L\n*   W\n*   D\n\n* * *\n\n## Team News\n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/1VBX4GQi1SHmErlM5fTALWDihsk=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fibrahimovic-augsburg-6ad1019cdd319253968717.jpg)\n\n© Iconsport / PictureAlliance\n\nAugsburg could be missing as many as six players on Saturday, including forward Alexis Claude-Maurice, who is not scheduled to return until early November.\n\nMichael Gregoritsch is likely to continue to lead the attacking line, supported by Anton Kade and Arijon Ibrahimovic in a front three.\n\nDefender Noahkai Banks is nearing a return from a knee injury, though he will not be available for the weekend's clash, meaning Chrislain Matsima, Jeffrey Gouweleeuw and Calvin Brackelmann are set to feature in central defence.\n\nAs for Union, there are doubts about the fitness of striker Andrej Ilic, so if he is unable to play, then expect to see Woo-Yeong Jeong and Tim Skarke stationed together in attack.\n\nMidfielders Andras Schafer and Rani Khedira, may play ahead of centre-backs Zeno Van den Bosch and Felix Uduokhai.\n\n**Augsburg possible starting lineup:**\n\nDahmen; Matsima, Gouweleeuw, Brackelmann; Fellhauer, Massengo, Rieder, Behrens; Kade, Ibrahimovic; Gregoritsch\n\n**Union Berlin possible starting lineup:**\n\nRonnow; Haberer, Van den Bosch, Uduokhai, Rothe; Aebischer, Schafer, Khedira, Imeri; Jeong, Skarke\n\n* * We say: Augsburg 3-1 Union Berlin\n\n  \n\nWhile Union have improved in recent weeks, it is hard to ignore the fact they have rarely travelled well.\n\nAugsburg have often managed to find the back of the net, and despite their poor form at the back, they should have enough offensive firepower to claim three points.\n\nFor data analysis of the most likely results, scorelines and more for this match
